label: One node per distinct structure
subgoals: Key each node by its operator and its operand ids
Look the key up in the unique table before creating a node

label: Canonical keys
subgoals: Sort the operands of a commutative node
Map a duplicate node to the id of its first copy
Rewrite later nodes through that map

label: Trivial simplification before hashing
subgoals: Replace AND of x with x by x
Replace AND of x with not x by constant 0
